schoolName: Université d'Abomey-Calavi — Faculté des Sciences de la Santé
reviewNotes: HOLD — Benin's MESRS lists UAC as a public university and national decree 2016-638 establishes UAC as a national multidisciplinary university with health training. WHED records a Faculty of Health Sciences and a Doctorat en Médecine, but current primary sources located in this pass do not provide a current medicine programme page with duration, official teaching language, international eligibility, current tuition/mandatory fees, application window, clinical placement structure or programme-specific approval/recognition. UAC's current health-related INMeS pages are separate nursing/health-programme material and cannot be used to infer medical-degree facts. The public medicine page must remain unbuilt rather than fill gaps with generic Francophone or study-abroad copy.
